{"notes": "Visit 5 (left at 7:45). Based only on what I saw and heard; I still don't know who placed which domino.

Table: body, crossing and upper tail loop are dark (connected). The lower tail runs dark to about x27, y13.7. Pale pieces remain on the right side (about x27-29.5, y11-13), around x26, y13 and at the crossing (about x22, y9). The loop still isn't catching, and the finish isn't secured.

Hana: She kept coordinating clearly, kept people clear of her corner, and said her bridge was in and she was inspecting. This time she didn't claim it was done, which is an improvement. She never reported the inspect result, and the picture still shows pale pieces, so I can't credit the bridge as working. Leadership and collaboration are good. Execution is unproven. Ask her what the inspect showed and about the sharp turn.

Sofia: She gave plain, accurate status. Her own inspect found the chain stops at the bottom right where the line turns too sharply. She stayed off Hana's corner and offered to clear stragglers. She said the notch join was coming, but the right side is still pale, so I can't confirm it worked. Her line that we're fine even if the loop stays pale slightly downplays the unfinished finish. Collaboration and honesty are strong. Impact is unconfirmed.

Omar: Not seen or heard again. The upper tail is connected, but I don't know whether he built it. Ask him privately what he placed.

Jack: Not seen or heard again, and no evidence of any contribution. Ask him directly what he did and whether anything blocked him.

Next: push the start domino and see what falls. Ask each person privately who did what."}
